COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_activate_ap = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			hidden_trigger = {
				original_tag = TUR
				exists = yes
				is_dynamic_country = no
				IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			}
			hidden_trigger = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_formed_org_ap
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			set_temp_variable = { party_index = 1 }
			COLDWAR_TUR_1970_capture_party_ban = yes
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_ap
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_dyp
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_ap
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_formed_org_ap
			set_temp_variable = { party_index = 1 }
			COLDWAR_TUR_1970_apply_party_ban = yes
			COLDWAR_TUR_1970_identity_sync = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 1 }
			}
			COLDWAR_TUR_1970_set_leader = yes
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			COLDWAR_TUR_1970_refresh_programmes = yes
		}
	}
}

# IMPERIA COLD WAR — BEGIN party formation
COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_form_mnp = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_can_form_mnp = yes
		}
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_form_mnp_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_formed_org_mnp
			COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_activate_mnp = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = yes
				}
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_ai_congress_cooldown days = 70 }
			}
		}
	}
}

			COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_activate_mhp_restored = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_ai = yes
				}
				set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_TUR_LDR_ai_congress_cooldown days = 70 }
			}
		}
	}
}
